requirements.description: Keep Wan at concurrency one until the repaired scheduler and a single-case smoke are verified
Start from initial capacity, ramp one slot per three successes, and reset to minimum on capacity failure
Perform a final poll and reconcile uncertain provider state for two hours without resubmission
Reject structured and configured prompt-limit violations before provider submission
Expose initial/effective capacity, success streak, reconciliation state, and safe polling diagnostics
Preserve historical terminal tasks, fair scheduling, writeback, stable assets, and manual retry semantics
Pass full automated and browser regression, deploy dev, then run exactly one Wan smoke case
